صَدَفِىٌّ A camel of a certain sort, (M, K, *) of excellent quality, (K,) [ISd says,] so called, (M, K,) I think, in relation to a tribe of Arabs of El-Yemen, (M,) or in relation to a sub-tribe (بَطْن) of Kindeh, (K,) called الصَّدِفُ. (M, K.) [See also صَرَفِىٌّ.] ＝
-A2- [Also a rel. n. from صَدَفٌ; Testaceous.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
